headline: Executive order sets up a temporary federal office to help coordinate US government support for Afghanistan.
what_it_does: This order creates a temporary organization inside the federal government. Based on its title, the office's job is to help organize and support US government work related to Afghanistan. No summary was provided, so details such as its exact tasks, staffing, funding, and how long it lasts are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: They would have a new temporary office meant to help coordinate the government's support efforts for Afghanistan.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on January 16, 2009; the source does not state an effective date.
